DynamicCache.description: Dynamic Cache settings, used by the 'OrchardCore.DynamicCache' feature. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/DynamicCache/.

FailoverRetryLatency.description: The time during which the dynamic cache stops using the distributed cache after a read or write failure, before trying again, as a TimeSpan in the 'hh:mm:ss' format.

OrchardCore_DynamicCache.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_DynamicCache' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:DynamicCache' instead.
